description: For financial advisors (requires a MySSAgent advisor account — sign in with your myssagent.com advisor account when prompted). Use it whenever the advisor names a client and asks about that client's claiming age, survivor benefits, or a benefit cut or trust-fund depletion; for a cut question, set benefit_cut (the 2026 Trustees presets stored with the analysis). Returns the stored Social Security claiming analysis for one of YOUR clients: optimal and recommended claiming ages, the benefit-by-claiming-age table computed from their Social Security earnings record, lifetime values, survivor analysis when present (for a married client, the survivor benefit in both death orders, and with survivor_scenario a named survivor and an engine-computed survivor total), and risk flags. Requires the advisor_client_id from list_clients — call that first when you only have a name. Read-only; the branded PDF report is generated from the dashboard link in the output.

advisor_client_id.description: The client's id from list_clients (a UUID).

benefit_cut.description: Optional. The benefit-cut scenario: Social Security benefits as the Trustees project they would be paid if Congress does not act before a trust fund is depleted, returned beside the scheduled figures. "trustees_oasi" is the 2026 Trustees Report projection for the Old-Age and Survivors Insurance fund (78% of scheduled benefits payable from October 2032); "trustees_combined" is the hypothetical combined retirement and disability funds (83% from July 2034); "custom" takes effective_month (YYYY-MM, 2027-01 to 2045-12) and payable_pct (50 to 100). Use it for questions about benefit cuts, trust-fund depletion or a haircut to Social Security. Payable figures, checks paid in full before the cut, and the breakeven shift come only from this parameter: they cannot be reproduced by applying a percentage to the scheduled figures, because checks paid before the effective month are paid in full. This tool prints the two Trustees presets stored with the client's last analysis; a custom assumption is computed by run_client_analysis.

survivor_scenario.description: Married clients only. A scenario the ADVISOR models: which spouse passes first and at what age. It is a planning input, not a recommendation. The report then names the survivor and gives, for each plan, the survivor's monthly benefit (reduced for age and RIB-LIM where they apply) and the engine's nominal total paid to the survivor from that death to their planning age. Set it only when the advisor has given both values; never choose a death age yourself. Without it the report gives the survivor floor in both death orders and no total.

age_at_death.description: That person's age at death, in years (decimals allowed, e.g. 66.5).

first_to_die.description: "client" is the person this advisor_client_id belongs to; "spouse" is their spouse.

name: get_client_report
title: Get a client's claiming analysis
